rationale: Independently re-derived at reviewed commit 3018a6591f54d3a37568db9c46dad0ddc0d32d90. My four prior-round asks are all RESOLVED: (1) lexical samePath gating was replaced by canonical Git-toplevel containment with directory-chain symlink resolution and toplevel-relative porcelain names; (2) real subdirectory and symlink-alias claim regressions now refuse before mutation and assert byte-identical state; (3) recording entanglement is derived from EventsPath/ManifestPath themselves and the supported custom-worktree-root e2e pin passes; (4) ComputeEntangleablePaths comments and ADR-0025 now describe the shipped conditional containment mechanism. The mandatory hard-block re-probes all passed uncached: subdirectory invocation refused byte-identically, symlink-alias invocation refused byte-identically, TestContainedRel_SymlinkLeafKeepsOwnTrackedName passed, and the real symlinked-.gitignore e2e refused byte-identically. Defensive overlay probes also passed for ordinary .. normalization, directory-symlink escape exclusion, directory-symlink re-entry canonicalization, hardlink-induced tracked .gitignore dirt, and case-alias invocation on this case-insensitive filesystem. A deliberately raw symlink/../file string exposes filepath.Dir's lexical-clean behavior at the helper primitive, but no production caller can supply that shape: all three call sites use filepath.Join-derived paths, spec IDs are validated, and worktree_root rejects .. segments. It is therefore not a reachable spec-branch-corrupting defect. Build and internal/gitutil tests passed; the bead worktree remained clean at the reviewed SHA and the /tmp probe directory was removed.

findings.title: Prior hard block cleared by all mandatory real refusal probes
findings.evidence: go test ./internal/next passed TestContainedRel_SymlinkLeafKeepsOwnTrackedName plus the subdirectory/symlink-alias toplevel, enumeration, and full-guard tests. go test ./cmd/mindspec passed TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_SubdirectoryInvocationRefusesByteIdentical, TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_SymlinkAliasInvocationRefusesByteIdentical, and all modified/deleted/renamed_away/symlinked legs of TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_GitignoreVariantsRefuseByteIdentical. The symlinked leg specifically proves a dirty symlinked .gitignore refuses without changing bytes, bead state, branches, worktrees, or the symlink target.
findings.impact: The round-2 branch-corruption reproducer is closed for direct, subdirectory, symlink-alias, and symlink-leaf invocation shapes.

findings.title: Custom-root and remaining filesystem edge probes found no reachable corruption path
findings.evidence: TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_EnumerationPin_CustomWorktreeRootRecording passed. Additional tests injected with go test -overlay (without touching the bead worktree) proved directory symlink escapes are excluded, re-entry is canonicalized, hardlink changes still surface as dirty .gitignore and block, and a case-only alias retains [.gitignore] after workspace.FindRoot on this case-insensitive filesystem. A raw symlink/../file probe demonstrated lexical cleaning inside the primitive, but rg found only the three guarded production call sites and each receives filepath.Join-composed, validated paths, making the raw shape unreachable.
findings.impact: No evidence-bearing spec-branch-corrupting defect remains; the primitive observation does not warrant a block or required change.

findings.title: Review environment left clean and byte-identical
findings.evidence: make build completed successfully (with the known non-fatal sandbox denial for the external Go module stat-cache write), go test ./internal/gitutil passed, final git status/diff/index checks were empty, HEAD remained 3018a6591f54d3a37568db9c46dad0ddc0d32d90, and /tmp/r6-spec128-edge-probe was removed.
findings.impact: The review introduced no bead-worktree mutation or lifecycle side effect.
